positions.name: KnowledgePurgeDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge should be purged from the organizational record?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding erasure of specific knowledge domains — src-1 targets concrete artifacts (the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts) while src-2 targets a broader category (zeppelin routes). They share the same authority-ranking relational stance, matter-of-fact register, present-irrealis temporal modality, and decision-level conviction: a position-holder exercising informational control by ordering what must be forgotten. The tension between concrete-artifact specificity and abstract-category generality is held by the frame rather than resolved.
